role: Pure decision functions extracted from VoiceConversationController's audio pipeline: whether a queued assistant stream started / a spoken response finished (by stream generation), whether a recogniser error is restartable, and whether a proactive workout trigger must wait because the user or assistant is mid-turn.
types: VoiceTurnPolicy: enum — namespace of static turn-taking predicates
VoiceTurnPolicy.StreamEdge: struct — (isStreaming, generation) snapshot of AssistantViewModel's stream
toplevel: restartableRecognitionErrors static set initialised with two 'domain:code' strings; StreamEdge is Equatable/Sendable synthesised.

units.does: Returns true when the observed stream edge `now` is streaming and its generation differs from the generation captured at wiring time; used to detect that a queued send started even when isStreaming collapsed true→false→true into one delivery.

Returns true when the stream stopped (`!now.isStreaming`) or a different stream generation replaced the wired one; tells the voice loop the spoken response is over so the remainder drains and the mic reopens.
Builds the key "<domain>:<code>" and returns true only if it is in restartableRecognitionErrors AND the conversation state is .listening.

branches.cond: domain:code key is in restartableRecognitionErrors (1110 / LSR 301)
branches.effect: true: falls through to return state == .listening; false: returns false (error not retried)

units.does: Decides whether a proactive trigger must wait: in .triggerSpeaking only an in-flight LLM task or synthesizer audio blocks; otherwise an LLM task or streaming response, synthesizer speaking in .speaking, a non-empty partial transcript in .listening, or .thinking state each block; else not busy.

branches.effect: true: returns hasInFlightLLMTask || synthesizerIsSpeaking (ignores streaming flag and partial transcript); false: continues to next check
true: busy; false: continue (synth speaking in other states, e.g. .listening, does not block)
true: busy (protects in-progress dictation from being wiped); false: continue
true: busy; false: falls to return false (trigger may play now)
